findings.value: Mostly live and DJ nights: a weekly Thursday jazz jam run by a resident band since 2016, free weekend afternoon canalside sessions of global and Latin-tinged live music, a monthly open jam, and DeepDig nights of long DJ sets.

evidence.quote: Since 2016, Stratos, our resident jazz band led by the talented and Mercury Prize-nominated Rio Kai, has held down this popular night
Join us canalside at Grow in Hackney Wick every Saturday and Sunday from 1-4pm for an afternoon of free live music
At DeepDig, we bring our favourite DJs to play the sets they don’t usually get to play at bigger venues or festivals.
